items.t: Disney Just Boosted Its Dividend by 33%. That Gives DIS Stock Investors a Real Reason to Stick Around.
items.sum: Disney increased its dividend by 33% to $2 per share annually while outlining about $3 billion in annual cost savings by fiscal 2029 and a $9 billion buyback target for fiscal 2027.

items.t: Morgan Stanley Maintains Overweight on Walt Disney, Raises Price Target to $138
items.sum: Morgan Stanley analyst Benjamin Swinburne maintains Walt Disney (NYSE:DIS) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $133 to $138.
